name: Admin Credentials Editor
author: Luqman Safay

sections.description:
The Admin Credentials Editor plugin allows site administrators to quickly update their login details without touching the database.
You can change the username, email address, or password of your admin account (individually or together) directly from the dashboard.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the admin-credentials-editor folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the “Admin Credentials Editor” menu to change your admin credentials.
sections.faq:
How do I change the admin username?

Use the “Admin Credentials Editor” menu in the dashboard.

Can I change only the password or email?

Yes, you can update username, email, or password individually.
